topics.headline: Eurozone HICP set to decelerate in June, breaking joint-rise scenario
topics.summary: Eurozone flash HICP is expected to fall to 2.8% from 3.2% as the oil-driven energy shock reverses, while US CPI momentum and inflation expectations still point higher; this divergence makes a simultaneous US-EU acceleration unlikely despite prediction markets pricing high odds for CPI alone staying elevated.

topics.headline: HY spreads sit near cycle lows at 2.67%, FOMC looms
topics.summary: Spreads have retraced most of the spring's Iran-conflict widening to sit at 2.67%, but heavy issuance, CCC-tier weakness, and a July 28-29 FOMC meeting inside the 30-day window leave room for a volatility-driven bounce off historically tight levels.

topics.headline: Bitcoin ETF flows stay net negative, momentum tilts against inflows
topics.summary: After a brief $510M three-day inflow streak in early July, Bitcoin ETFs reverted to outflows on July 9-10 (FBTC and ARKB leading exits while IBIT sat flat), suggesting the prior bounce was tactical dip-buying rather than institutional re-engagement; all eyes now turn to July 14 CPI data as the key catalyst before the July 28-29 Fed meeting.

topics.headline: VIX near lows, but compression looks fragile amid rising realized vol
topics.summary: VIX sits around 15.3-16.4, well below its trailing-month average of 17.54, yet realized S&P volatility has nearly doubled since June and Goldman's Panic Index (correlation, skew, VIX composite) just hit a two-year low — a classic pre-unwind divergence that, combined with Fed-hike odds rising and Iran oil-export risk, favors VIX reverting upward toward its 3-month average over the next 30 days.

topics.headline: Chevron-Microsoft 2.67GW deal confirms near-certain weekly PPA cadence
topics.summary: Chevron just signed a 20-year, 2.67GW power deal with Microsoft (Project Kilby), the latest in an unbroken run of hyperscaler generation deals (Meta, Google, Oracle/OpenAI) that, combined with FERC's grid-reliability push, makes another major announcement within 30 days highly likely.
